note: Hand-labeled ground truth for BRO-985 (Reddit sentiment classifier over-labeling mild/comparative comments as negative). Categories: comparative, lukewarm, scorecard_meta, negative, positive, edge. Each item's `expected` is the ground-truth {is_relevant, sentiment}. `sentiment` is omitted when is_relevant is false.

items.postTitle: Proof, Becky Shaw, or Fallen Angels?
items.body: I'd pick Becky Shaw over Fallen Angels if you can only see one, but Fallen Angels was still a great time.

items.postTitle: Proof, Becky Shaw, or Fallen Angels?
items.body: Becky Shaw was far superior for me, but I wouldn't say Fallen Angels was bad, just not my top pick of the three.

items.postTitle: Which revival is worth the money this spring?
items.body: Between the two I'd rank Fallen Angels below the other revival, mostly because I already knew the play. Didn't hate it though.

items.postTitle: Proof, Becky Shaw, or Fallen Angels?
items.body: Fallen Angels was the weakest of the three for me - the pacing dragged and the leads had zero chemistry. Becky Shaw was much better written.

items.postTitle: Spring play roundup - which to see
items.body: Saw both. Fallen Angels made me laugh way more than the other one, though the other has stronger performances overall.
I liked Present Laughter more, it's just a stronger play, but Fallen Angels has Consuelos who was fun to watch.

items.postTitle: Two Coward revivals this season, thoughts?
items.body: Honestly comparing the two isn't fair since Fallen Angels is a much lighter play, but on its own terms it delivered exactly what it promised.

items.postTitle: Proof, Becky Shaw, or Fallen Angels?
items.body: Went with Fallen Angels over the other two based on reviews. Wish I'd picked differently - it just didn't land for me and I wouldn't recommend it over the alternatives.

items.postTitle: What should I see this weekend, Fallen Angels or a musical?
items.body: I'd do the musical instead honestly, Fallen Angels is a slighter show, but I don't regret seeing it.
My friend liked the other Coward revival better than this one but I actually preferred Fallen Angels - laughed the whole time.
It was fine. Nothing amazing but a pleasant enough evening.
